verdict.rationale: Penpot documents a first-party MCP server and plugin/API surface explicitly framed for 'external rendering' and code/asset export (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON), and a runtime probe confirms the MCP server actually boots and completes a handshake with a tools capability. However, no evidence shows a concrete render/export tool being invoked (e.g., generating a screenshot or production asset via API/MCP), and one community report describes past difficulty exporting a full design as a single file/image rather than per-layer. Missing for 10: a demonstrated render/export tool call producing an image or production file through the MCP/API, and resolution of the older export-limitation complaint.
